name: Wang Han
bio: Wang Han is dated by Giles to the 8th century AD. His poem here is a soldier’s drinking song.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: A Reason Fair
poems.author: Wang Han

poems.title: A Song of Liang-chou
poems.author: Wang Han
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
They sing, they drain their cups of jade,
They strum on horseback their guitars.
. . . Why laugh when they fall asleep drunk on the sand? —
How many soldiers ever come home?
